name: Floating Music Box Garden
description: A garden where music boxes float like lanterns, each spin releasing bursts of golden melody light.
prompt: Serene garden with whimsical floating music boxes suspended in air, their lids opening to release sparkling golden notes that drift like light, surrounded by blooming night flowers, dreamy atmosphere.
caption: Music that floats and shines—let the garden play its melody. 🎵✨
